title: Verify: App playing view unit tests
summary: Unit tests for hotspot, action and dialogue flow through App
description: Extend game/frontend/tests/app.test.tsx with tests for the playing view using the real useGame against jsdom localStorage (cleared by tests/setup.ts) and the bedroom.yaml content bundled by content.ts.
acceptance_criteria: After Begin the scene, hotspots, toggle and opening dialogue render
Hotspot click opens the action menu
Search records history and opens the bookshelf
technical_constraints: Fixture is the real content in game/content/worlds/the-boys-room/scenes/bedroom.yaml; do not hard-code a copy

steps.action: Add describe('App playing view') with afterEach(cleanup) and a helper begin() that renders <App /> and clicks the Begin button. Add test 'Given Begin clicked, then scene, hotspots, Story toggle and opening dialogue render': call begin(), assert screen.getByRole('img',{name:'Bedroom'}), screen.getByRole('button',{name:'Bookshelf'}), screen.getByRole('button',{name:'Story'}) and screen.getByText("I don't know what to do next. What should we do?") exist.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/app.test.tsx -t 'opening dialogue render'

steps.action: Add test 'Given the game view, when Bookshelf is clicked, then Inspect, Push, Search and Leave buttons appear': begin(), fireEvent.click(getByRole('button',{name:'Bookshelf'})), assert getByRole('button',{name:'Inspect'}), 'Push', 'Search', 'Leave' exist.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/app.test.tsx -t 'Search and Leave'

steps.symbol: test: search updates history and door
steps.action: Add test 'Given Bookshelf menu, when Search is clicked, then history shows the hidden door text and the hotspot is open': begin(), click Bookshelf, click Search, assert screen.getByText('A hidden door swings open behind the books.') exists and the Bookshelf button has attribute data-open='true'.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/app.test.tsx -t 'hidden door text'

steps.action: Add test 'Given the opening dialogue, when Look around the room is clicked, then dialogue closes and history keeps the choice': begin(), the Choose button text count: click getByRole('button',{name:'Look around the room'}); then assert screen.queryByRole('button',{name:'Look around the room'}) is null and screen.getByRole('list',{name:'Story history'}) toHaveTextContent('Look around the room').
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/app.test.tsx
